about: Spec 011's answer key, written by hand from spec.md, teaching-design.md and the declared values in mentor/dev/build-practice-comp-2b.jsx and build-overlaps-b.jsx (never by running mentor/lib/anchor.mjs). Times in seconds at 30 fps. 'times' is the --times list each Mentor Practice 2 capture needs in the sitting (research R4). T234 (2026-10-26) checked every value against the live captures of the 2026-10-26 sitting (specs/011-anchor/live-sitting-2026-10-26.md); every value the live comp shows differently has a 'note' next to it, or in 'live_notes'. Ranks and needed times are FR-004's and R4's rules applied by hand to the captured raw facts (keys, parents, rectangles), with shapes as default candidates since L-1 (SHAPES_DEFAULT true).

times.why: The --times list every Mentor Practice 2 capture was taken with: Gauge's rest key (3.167, Rotation 0), Pop's (4.3, full size), Sled's Position keys (3.667, 4.167, 4.667) and Gradient's (5.433, 6.433)
times.needed_note: T234, live: the live Mentor Practice 2 has 40 layers, not the stand-in's wave B 19, so what neededTimes() asks for is longer than the --times list. By hand, every layer that isn't structurally never (all but Wobble, Hatch Rig, Seal): rest keys Spinner 0.25 (Rotation 0), Card 2.4 (largest Scale), Badge 4.5, Gauge 3.167, Pop 4.3, Tile 5.367; Position keys Card 1.2, 2.4; Dot 1 0, 0.5, 1.5; Dot 2 0.5, 1.5; Dot 3 0.5, 1.25, 1.5; Chip A to C 2, 3; Flag 4, 4.5, 5.5; Pause 5, 5.5, 6, 6.5; Sled 3.667, 4.167, 4.667; Tile 4.167, 5.167; Stamp 4.667, 5.667; Row A 4.8, 5.8; Row C 5.167, 6.167; Plate 5.3, 6.3; Gradient 5.433, 6.433. 30 times, under the 63 cap. The captures hold the --times list, comp.time and each layer's own key times, so a lesson on this comp takes a second read (R4)

practice2b.proposal_note: T234, live: was Door, middle-left. With shapes default since L-1, the live comp's older shapes rank too: Blink (index 1, key types' shape, 40 x 120, no Position, Rotation or Scale keys, unparented, its anchor at [0, 0]) ranks first by layer order, and it's tall, so it turns from the middle of its bottom edge. Door is 3rd, after Cut

Lid.note: T234 (L-1): was if_named, shape_until_l1. A default candidate now; its anchor isn't at its centre or [0, 0], so it ranks after every unkeyed layer whose pivot is where AE put it

practice2b.ranking_why: Unparented first (Hatch, Shadow below), no Rotation or Scale keys next (Spinner, Badge, Gauge, Pop below), a pivot where AE put it next (Lid below), then layer order; Flip is flipped, so it ranks last (row 18). T234: the live comp has the older layers (Blink to Pause, key types' and offset's) and skill 6's (Tile to Shadow) as well as the wave B ones, and shapes are default since L-1, so every rank moved; ranks 1 to 19 by hand from the captured keys and parents

lid-group.note: T234, live (L-1): was hints group_anchor. AE moved the group's own Anchor and Position together, so the rectangle didn't shift in layer space and the snapshot strict-matches the base: nothing this skill reads changed. Lid's own pivot is still where it was, outside the shape, so the check says outside. Row 22's group hint can't fire on this (for the spec writer)

pop-shrunk.note: T234, live (L-4): AE set Pop's anchor to [120, 960] (Pop's Position read as a layer point), not the stand-in's [60, 120], with Position unchanged. Nothing shows at 3.3 s; at full size Pop draws far off its place, its pivot far outside it. The check grades it set away from rest (item 3) and the one hint is away_from_rest; item 1 reads outside, which the hint order doesn't add

sled-slid.note: T234, live (L-2): AE added a Position key at frame 0 (the playhead) and left the three keys as they were; the stand-in guessed it rewrote the first. Sled holds still at 0 s and slides the same 50 px at every old key, so the worst key is the first one, 3.667, and the added key is an other change

sled-on-key.note: T234, live extra (L-2): the playhead on the first key (3.667). AE rewrote only that key; the other two stay, so Sled slides 50 px at 4.167 and 4.667 and no key is added. The baseline is the live base with its playhead at 3.667, where the learner started (the base holds samples there)

demo-separated-xy.note: T234, live extra (L-4): the demo on Tab with Position separated, written as X and Y. The read can't tell separated from not, and the check passes it the same way

sled_with_door.why: Sled isn't a default candidate (Position keyed), so the demo goes on entry 0

lid_with_banner.note: T234 (L-1): was null with not_a_default_candidate; shapes are default candidates now, so Banner (entry 1) takes the demo

sled_with_gradient.why: T234: takes over lid_with_banner's old case. Both have Position keys, so neither is a default candidate

review.note: T234, live: was Tab and 8. With Door and Needle in the record, the review's pick is the first default candidate with no Rotation or Scale keys, unparented, by layer order: Blink. 19 default candidates on the live comp, less Door and Needle

live_notes.sign-left: Sign left-justified: its letters' rectangle starts 2.455 px right of its pivot (the log rounds it to 2.45) (the stand-in had 0), and the pivot is on the baseline, so it reads between places. Centred, the rectangle is 145.628 wide from -73.393 (the stand-in had 128 from -64). L-5: within 1 px of the ink both ways
live_notes.sign-left-check: Graded against the base with Sign as the focus, the justification change shifts Sign's rectangle (its anchor and Position unchanged), so item 2 fails and the hint is group_anchor, whose wording is about a shape's group (for the spec writer)
